meta.title: What happens when someone joins
meta.subtitle: One new team member, from a push on GitHub to her first row of data

views.label: The part that happens once
views.note: GitHub appears on the first line and never again. It is how the app gets published, not how it runs.

views.label: Creating the account
views.note: Supabase stores the account. A database trigger quietly creates her profile row at the same moment.

views.label: Signing in and loading data
views.note: The token carries her email. Every row she asks for is checked against it inside Postgres.

messages.label: push to main
messages.note: Vercel copies the files and puts them online. This already happened, long before Marina existed. GitHub takes no part in anything below this line.

messages.label: index.html + config.js
messages.note: Two files, and Vercel is finished. It never sees an issue, a comment or a password.

messages.label: signUp()
messages.note: The browser talks to Supabase directly. There is no server of ours in between.

messages.label: store the account
messages.note: A trigger fires here that nobody sees: it creates her profile row in app_users, guesses her name from her address, and makes her an admin only if she is the very first person.

messages.label: confirms the address
messages.note: Safe for Savills mail security to pre-click. Confirming is the whole job, so a scanner opening it first changes nothing.

messages.label: token carrying her email
messages.note: Every request from here on carries this token. It is what proves she is marina.curto@savills.ie.

messages.label: is_team() reads the token
messages.note: Checked inside the database on every single row. Not in the page, so it cannot be bypassed by editing the page or calling the API directly.

messages.label: her permitted rows
messages.note: A non-Savills address reaches exactly this point and gets nothing back. The app loads, and is empty.

messages.label: live changes from now on
messages.note: An issue Kushagra raises appears on Marina's screen a second later, with nobody refreshing.

cards.title: GitHub appears once, at the top
items: It publishes the app. It does not run it.
Nothing below the first line involves GitHub at all.
If GitHub vanished, the live app would carry on working.
You would just have no way to change it, and no history.

cards.title: Vercel hands over two files and stops
items: index.html is the app; config.js says which database to talk to.
After that the browser talks to Supabase directly.
Vercel never sees an issue, a comment, or a password.
This is why there is no server of ours to maintain.

cards.title: Supabase does three separate jobs
items: Keeps the account and checks the password.
Issues a token proving who she is.
Stores the data, and gates every row against that token.
Pushes changes live to everyone who has the app open.

cards.title: The step you cannot see
items: Storing the account fires a database trigger.
It creates her profile row, so she appears in Setup.
Her name is guessed from her email address; she can correct it.
The first person ever to sign in becomes administrator. Everyone after is a member.

cards.title: Where a stranger would stop
items: Anyone can open the link and reach the sign-in screen.
Anyone can create an account with any address.
They get a real token and the app loads normally.
Then every query returns nothing, because the gate reads the address in the token. The app works perfectly and is completely empty.
